text.Krediyi Erken Kapatmak Avantajlı mı? - K: Is Paying Off a Loan Early Worth It? - KredimGeldi
text.Krediyi erken kapatınca ne kadar kazanır: How much do you save by paying off a loan early? We explain the early repayment discount, the early repayment fee on home loans and partial prepayment options, with an example.
text.İkramiye, prim ya da bir satıştan eline: The first question on the minds of many people who receive a lump sum from a bonus, a commission or a sale is: Should I pay off my loan early? The answer depends on your loan type, the remaining term and whether you can put your money to work elsewhere.
text.Alınmaz, kalan faizden indirim yapılır: None charged; the remaining interest is discounted
text.Kalan vade 36 ay ve altı: en fazla %1, 3: Remaining term of 36 months or less: up to 1%; more than 36 months: up to 2% (of the principal repaid early)
text.Örnek: Ne kadar tasarruf edersiniz?: Example: How much do you save?
text.100.000 TL'lik, 12 ay vadeli ve vergiler: Let's take a 100,000 TL personal loan with a 12-month term and a monthly cost of 3.90% including taxes. The monthly installment is 10,593.48 TL.
text.Ödemediğiniz faiz ve vergi: Interest and taxes you don't pay
text.Kapama tutarı, ödeme gününe göre işlemiş: The bank finalizes the payoff amount by adding the interest accrued up to the payment date.
text.Tüm birikiminizi erken kapamaya harcamay: Don't spend all your savings on early repayment. Keeping a reserve that covers a few months of essential expenses keeps you from taking on new debt.
text.Erken kapama nasıl yapılır?: How do you repay a loan early?
text.Bankanızın mobil uygulaması, internet şu: Find out the current payoff amount from your bank's mobile app, online banking or customer service.
text.Tutarı kredi hesabınıza veya bağlı vades: Deposit the amount into your loan account or the linked checking account.
text.Kapama talimatını verin ve işlemin tamam: Give the payoff instruction and keep the receipt showing the transaction was completed.
text.Konut veya taşıt kredisiyse ipotek ya da: If it's a home or vehicle loan, follow up on the removal of the mortgage or lien.
text.Yeni bir krediyle mevcut borcunuzu daha: See whether you can move your existing debt to better terms with a new loan.
text.İhtiyaç kredisini erken kapatınca ceza ö: Do I pay a penalty if I pay off a personal loan early?
text.Hayır. İhtiyaç ve taşıt kredilerinde erk: No. No early repayment fee is charged on personal and vehicle loans; the bank is required to discount the remaining interest.
text.Konut kredisini erken kapatmanın maliyet: What does it cost to pay off a home loan early?
text.Sabit faizli konut kredilerinde kalan va: For fixed-rate home loans, a fee of up to 1% of the principal repaid early may be charged if the remaining term is 36 months or less, and up to 2% if it is longer. There is no fee on variable-rate loans.
text.Kısmi ödeme yapabilir miyim?: Can I make a partial payment?
text.Evet. Kredinin bir kısmını erken ödeyere: Yes. By repaying part of the loan early, you can reduce the installment amount or the term.

html.6502 sayılı Tüketicinin Korunması Hakkın: Under Consumer Protection Law No. 6502, a consumer may repay all or part of a loan before it is due. In this case, the bank is required to discount the interest and other costs attributable to the amount repaid early. In other words, you don't pay interest on future unpaid installments; you pay the remaining principal and the interest accrued up to that day.
html.<i class=\"ri-calculator-line\" aria-hid: Paying off after the 6th installment
html.Eşit taksitli kredilerde faizin büyük kı: With equal-installment loans, most of the interest is paid in the first months. That's why the benefit of early repayment is highest at the start of the term; the gain from paying off when only a few installments remain is limited.
html.<strong>Kredinizin maliyeti, paranızın g: If your loan costs more than your money earns. For example, if your loan cost including taxes is higher than the deposit return you could earn on your savings, paying off the debt is usually more profitable.
html.<strong>Vadenin başındaysanız.</strong>: If you're at the start of the term. The amount of interest you avoid is highest during this period.
html.<strong>Birden fazla borcunuz varsa</str: If you have more than one debt, pay off the most expensive one first (usually credit card or overdraft account debt).
html.Krediyi tamamen kapatmak yerine <strong>: Instead of paying off the loan entirely, you can also make a partial early repayment (partial prepayment). Ask your bank whether the partial prepayment will lower the installment amount or shorten the term. Shortening the term reduces total interest more; lowering the installment eases your monthly budget.
